primary_task: Build an MCP server with React + Fluent UI widgets for a Microsoft 365 Copilot declarative agent, expose it through a devtunnel, verify with MCP Inspector, provision the agent with atk and print test links.

requirements.name: AskUserQuestion (path selection)
requirements.evidence: 'You MUST use `AskUserQuestion` to ask the user whether they want OAI Apps or MCP Apps Extension before writing any code'
requirements.basis: tools: 'ask_user: ask the user a question (with options) and read the answer in the conversation'.

requirements.name: Node/npm packages (@fluentui/react-components, react, react-dom, @modelcontextprotocol/inspector)
requirements.evidence: 'If any of these packages are missing, install them automatically before continuing'; 'npx @modelcontextprotocol/inspector@0.20.0 --cli ...'
requirements.basis: bash: 'install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm ...)' and 'start and stop local servers inside the session'.

requirements.name: devtunnel (Microsoft Dev Tunnels) with login
requirements.evidence: 'MCP server and devtunnel MUST be spawned as independent OS processes'; 'AUTO-DEPLOY ON COMPLETION (REQUIRED - DO NOT SKIP): 1. Start MCP server + devtunnel in the background'; 'devtunnel user login -g -d'; 'MCP via tunnel: https://<tunnel-url>/mcp'
requirements.basis: lacks: 'network access to hosts outside the egress allow-list ... Microsoft Learn and Azure endpoints' and 'accounts, logins ... for external services'; the Dev Tunnels service is not on the allow-list.

requirements.name: Microsoft 365 tenant account for `atk provision` and M365 Copilot Chat
requirements.evidence: 'npx -y --package @microsoft/m365agentstoolkit-cli atk provision --env local'; 'Test in Copilot: https://m365.cloud.microsoft/chat/?titleId={M365_TITLE_ID from env/.env.local}'
requirements.basis: lacks: 'accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (... SaaS products ...)' and 'connectors or integrations other than the tools listed'; forbid_effects: 'publishes'.

requirements.name: declarative-agent-developer skill (delegation for agent scaffolding)
requirements.basis: tools: 'skill: load an installed Claude Code skill'; installation is not stated.

notes: Reading taken: the numbered 'AUTO-DEPLOY ON COMPLETION (REQUIRED)' flow (tunnel, E2E via tunnel URL, provision, Copilot test link) is part of the deliverable. Other reading: if only the local MCP server and widgets are the deliverable (localhost:3001 widget links are given), those parts are achievable with npm; the tunnel and provisioning would then be conditional and the verdict ACHIEVABLE. The PowerShell snippets are alternatives to the Linux nohup ones.
